Chapter 6499: Everlasting Supreme Immortal

Chapter 6499: Everlasting Supreme Immortal

The group exchanged glances and thought about the current dilemma. The two realms weren’t enough to withstand Li Qiye. Begging for mercy was not an option either.

Therefore, they had to fight to the end but it would look pathetic due to the difference in power. However, there was hope in this immortal flame.

“Very well.” They agreed with him.

“One side will perish today.” Seventy-two became confident after garnering enough support. He gritted his teeth while his heart devil told him to kill Li Qiye. That was the only way to rid himself of the trauma.

He hated the imperious cultivators who toyed with others’ fates, forgetting that he also belonged to this group.

Unfortunately, the heart devil told him he was a victim. All of his suffering originated because of Li Qiye and it was time for vengeance.

“Expand the realms!” He roared.

“So be it.” The longevity spirit and Lord of Paragon were more than happy to accommodate these primal ancestors, giving them incredible power.

“Combine!” They roared, no longer needing to seize the powers of the dream worlds with the formation.

Instead, they used it for empowerment - boosting their vitality and true fate to the highest state to endure more power.

The true god from Paragomn looked like a whale capable of pulling the whole dream world. Space twisted chaotically from its presence.

As for Paramount, it turned into an immortal with a maelstrom in the chest area. It sucked in the past and the future, conjuring endless chaos with a faint hint of the primordial.

“This is it.” The longevity spirit was satisfied with this creation.

The two beings could blow out the minor dream realms with one exhale.

“Lend me your power!” Seventy-two shouted.

The true god from Paragon appeared behind the longevity immortal. Various paragon forces melted and entered the immortal.

Paragon and Paramount started fusing, conjuring a primordial world capable of replacing Three Immortals.

“This is...” Alch-deer and North Kun were amazed.

The maelstrom pulled the two dream worlds together, forming a supreme vessel.

“Everlasting Supreme Immortal!” Seventy-two and the longevity spirit shouted excitedly.

Those within the vessel thought they had become unbeatable. Victory was theirs.

“You’re finished!” They chose not to use the immortal flame, wanting to test this vessel out against Li Qiye.

The vessel could grasp all affinities as it moved its hand - something cultivators couldn’t master.

“Slay Immortal Slash!” The vessel gained an immortal fiery aura, burning the dream fabrics around it.

The dream world lost its colors, sounds, and powers. The slash incinerated everything along the way.

Minor dream realms burned like paper windows. Gaping holes appeared with images of the real world.

Many screamed in horror and died. The natives of the minor realms were massacred; only a few cultivators were fortunate enough to escape to the real world in time.

“Bam!” The slash divided the dream world into two halves. Only a small number of realms remained, Gold Village included.

Everyone stared at the aftermath and couldn’t find Li Qiye.
